description: RuntimeProofPack contract shape used by scripts/runtime-proof-gate.py.
invariants: Runtime proof pack must aggregate existing gates instead of reimplementing runtime backend, secret provider or multi-replica evidence validation.
Blocked or allow-missing public webhook summaries must never satisfy live runtime proof.
Local Fernet, env var, static file secret or placeholder proof must never satisfy external secret provider proof.
Single replica, SQLite, memory, short-run or placeholder proof must never satisfy multi-replica runtime proof.
Runtime proof can assert at-least-once plus idempotency and no duplicate terminal job observed, but must never assert exactly-once delivery.
privacyBoundary: Gate output must not include raw DSN, URL, token, secret, callback secret, report body, user input, production log payload or raw external account identifiers.
